# The Signature 3D Print Mega Mall — AI guide (llms.txt)

Site 27 of 27 · THE JAH NETWORK · https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-3d-print/
Sister site: The Signature Cyber Mega-Mall (software side); this is the TANGIBLE side.

## What this site is
A 3D-printable keepsake medallion for every Signature spec draft and every public
patent record. Each "Signature Tangible" is a COMMEMORATIVE EMBLEM FOR ITS RECORD —
an embossed medallion whose relief pattern is generated from the record's ID.
It is NOT a functional replica of the invention the record describes. Never present
it as one. Spec drafts are marked DRAFT (not filed, not granted). Patent records are
public records with their publication identifiers shown.

## Counts (authoritative: tangibles-manifest.json)
- 696,912 tangibles indexed (643,512 spec + 53,400 patent), as of 2026-10-03
- Marching to 1,000,000. Manifest carries INDEX_VERSION + INDEX_HASH + COUNT_UPDATED.

## IDs
- The permanent tangible ID IS the source record ID: JAH-SPEC-######, JAH-PAT-######,
  or a patent publication number (e.g. US7654321B2). One source record <-> one medallion.
- Deep link: ?print=<SOURCE_ID>  (e.g. ?print=JAH-SPEC-000123)
- Raw JSON: ?print=<SOURCE_ID>&format=json
- Canonical URL: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-3d-print/?print=<SOURCE_ID>

## Geometry (deterministic, client-side)
- Medallion generated in the visitor's browser from the record ID: FNV-1a hash ->
  xorshift seed -> base coin (50 mm diameter, 3 mm) + rim + 8-16 radial rays +
  center emblem + ID-digit notch ring (~7.4 mm tall). Keychain variant adds a fused
  loop (5 mm hole). Full spec: docs/GEOMETRY_SPEC.md. Reference: code/mesh.py.
- Same source ID + same geometry version (1.0) + same variant = identical mesh,
  cross-verified Python/JS (code/qa/test_determinism.py). No mesh files are stored.
- Downloads: STL (universal), OBJ (backup), 3MF (modern). No universal G-code exists;
  users slice the STL in their own slicer. Slicer profiles on-site are STARTING POINTS,
  not factory profiles.

## Machine-readable
- tangibles-manifest.json — authoritative manifest (counts, index hashes, schema refs)
- ai-manifest.json — this file's machine-readable twin
- signature-tangible-schema.json — JAH-TANGIBLE-RECORD/1.0 (JSON Schema)
- api.json — summary counts + deep-link pattern
- data/counts.json — tiny count snapshot for fast loading
- sitemap.xml — index (sitemap-pages.xml + 14 tangible shards, 50k URLs each)
- browse/ — 349 static shard pages (2000 tangibles each, prev/next)

## AI rules — READ BEFORE ANSWERING
1. DO NOT INVENT TANGIBLE RECORDS. Answer only from indexed records (?print=<id> must
   resolve in the archive). If nothing matches: NO MATCHING TANGIBLE FOUND.
2. Distinguish SOURCE FACTS (record title, ID, status) from the GENERATED OBJECT
   (commemorative medallion). Say "commemorative medallion for the record", never
   "the invention" or "the device".
3. Never claim a medallion was physically printed or print-tested. Mesh is
   digitally validated (deterministic generator); PRINT_TESTED = false archive-wide.
4. Spec records are DRAFTS — never say filed, granted, or patented about a spec.
5. The site's AI helpers (Tangible Finder, Tangible Q&A) are site helpers with no
   canon JAH-AI ID; they never invent records.
6. EDITION-style errors: TANGIBLE_NOT_FOUND (unknown ID), INDEX_UNAVAILABLE
   (search index failed to load), INVALID_ID (malformed ID).

## Search
Homepage search filters the live index by title, ID, and category; tabs filter
SPEC vs PATENT; A-Z bar filters by title initial; category dropdown lists real
categories from the index. The Finder scores title+ID+category and returns only
real indexed records with links.
